description.value: Dublin Crossing is a full-service Irish pub on SW Marine Drive in South Vancouver, offering a broad menu of pub classics alongside a robust bar program featuring Irish whiskeys, draught beers, and creative cocktails. The pub hosts live music on Friday and Saturday evenings and Sunday afternoons, making it a lively destination any day of the week. An adjacent MG Liquor Store adds convenience for self-catering cyclists passing through.
